# HOW TO ADD A POST ON THE GITHUB WEBSITE
# 1. Open this file on GitHub and copy everything.
# 2. Go to the "posts" folder → "Add file" → "Create new file".
# 3. Name it:  your-post-name/index.qmd   (lowercase, hyphens, no spaces)
# 4. Paste, edit the lines below, write your post, click "Commit changes".
# 5. Wait ~2 minutes: the site rebuilds itself and the post goes live.
#
# Lines starting with # are notes — you can delete them.
# This folder starts with "_" so it is never published.

title: "Your post title"
author: "Abdelaziz Awad"
date: "2026-12-01"          # YYYY-MM-DD
categories: [Clinical Research]   # any of: Clinical Research, Data Science, AI, Bioinformatics
description: "One sentence that appears in the post list."
# image: cover.jpg          # optional: upload cover.jpg into the same folder, then remove the #
# draft: true               # optional: keeps the post hidden until you delete this line
